en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over an early‑20th‑century European city. In the foreground are cultivated fields or vineyards and a solitary three‑storey house along a country road. Behind it stretch low‑rise residential blocks, gardens and small industrial buildings with several tall smokestacks. In the distance, a hilly ridge frames the city, and on the right side stands a large, ornate institutional building or palace‑like structure. The overall scene mixes farmland at the edge of town with an expanding industrial urban area.
